data.headline: Nasdaq futures net longs rise in both categories
data.summary: Asset managers and leveraged funds increased their net longs in E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures between October 27 and November 3. The ten-year Treasury yield later ticked up to 4.86% on November 6.

bull.text: The asset-manager net long rose from 65,381 to 73,137 contracts and the leveraged-fund net long rose from 2,301 to 10,073.

bear.text: The ten-year yield rose from 4.84% to 4.86% from November 5 to 6. Higher discount rates can weigh on valuations that depend heavily on distant cash flows.

watch.text: E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures open interest rose from 268,508 to 292,587 contracts over the same CFTC reporting week. Compare the next position report with this larger base of open contracts.

limitations: The Treasury yields are dated November 6. This report has no verified ETF closing-price or return observation.
The CFTC observations are weekly futures positions as of November 3. ETF flows and investor intent require separate evidence.
